title: Outcome table (tables/<id>.json)
description: One weighted outcome table. A table is mod content: the server ingests, validates and rolls it; a mod never computes an outcome. Entry keys are auto-namespaced namespace:key on the wire. `value` and `roll` are mutually exclusive; a nested `roll` reuses the roll spec {sides,count,keep?} and its total becomes the outcome value. `where` is a 10.2 condition evaluated against the live store.

id.description: Local table id; full id is namespace:id.

entries.description: Weighted outcome entries. Non-empty is enforced semantically.

value.description: Outcome value when no nested roll is present.

roll.description: Optional nested roll; its total becomes the value.

where.description: Optional 10.2 condition; ineligible entries are excluded.
